method: Python integers and Fraction only; no sampled frequencies and no floating-point certificates
execution_contract: Public Rogerhu12/math-research-public GitHub Actions only for this new execution

scope.input: all complete Airy wave inputs, including mean and both Fourier cones
scope.smoothing: P_high(U-I-integral K): H^s -> H^(s+4/3), |s|<=1, norm < 2^4096 b^(4/3)

gates.name: Airy_height_two_factor_fee
gates.detail: Each height factor costs 2^6; the exact constant Wronskian and two-row norm cost at most 2^4.

gates.name: far_lag_12_complete_fee
gates.detail: 14th lag moment; (M/16)^-12; both block Schur directions retained.

gates.name: commutator_near_complete_fee
gates.detail: Second lag moment safely pays the Lipschitz factor and comparability.

gates.name: rescaled_cutoff_fee
gates.detail: Rescaling by at most 16 in the far-lag bound is included.

gates.name: all_nested_thresholds_inside_paid_high_regime
gates.detail: The smallest buffer is M/64; M >= 2^4200 b.

gates.name: elementary_Grönwall_factor
gates.detail: The proved exponents are much smaller than 1/4; no floating exponential is used.

gates.name: near_two_Volterra_fee
gates.detail: Two full K factors at comparable high frequencies and the new row norm < 2.

gates.name: outer_far_two_Volterra_fee
gates.detail: One far K, one old full K, and the old full U norm.

gates.name: inner_far_two_Volterra_fee
gates.detail: The outer near K retains its M^-2/3 factor.

gates.name: three_Volterra_terms_to_row_budget
gates.detail: The true ordered triangle integral is bounded by the unit square; no missing factor is needed.

gates.name: inner_zero_initial_buffer_fee
gates.detail: The nested inner cutoff has zero initial data for inputs <= M/16.

gates.name: outer_nested_commutator_fee
gates.detail: The second commutator is used only on W2, after the exact decomposition.

gates.name: outer_nested_far_fee
gates.detail: The complement of the second cutoff forces a true large Fourier lag.

gates.name: far_first_integral_subtraction
gates.detail: The identity block is zero on separated bands; the exact first integral is retained and subtracted.

gates.name: far_band_sum_fee
gates.detail: Includes both nested terms and the far first-integral block.

gates.name: cube_root_rational_upper
gates.detail: Optional exact bracket for all displayed fractional exponents.

gates.name: negative_one_dyadic_sum
gates.detail: sum_{k>=0} 2^-k = 2; the finite sum used in a row is strictly smaller.

gates.name: negative_one_third_dyadic_sum
gates.detail: This dominates the exact geometric series uniformly over all deep shells.

gates.name: negative_five_thirds_dyadic_sum
gates.detail: 2^-5/3 < 1/2; the actual series is smaller.

gates.name: positive_one_third_finite_dyadic_sum
gates.detail: Reverse the finite sum and divide by the last scale^(1/3).

gates.name: near_band_count
gates.detail: Covers scales between M/32 and 32M, including endpoint conventions.

gates.name: near_weight_fee
gates.detail: |s|<=1 comparability, actual <m> weights, and all near neighbors.

gates.name: far_weight_high_output
gates.detail: Weighted high-output block <= C b^4/3 M^-1/3 N^-1.

gates.name: far_weight_high_input
gates.detail: Weighted high-input block <= C b^4/3 M^1/3 N^-5/3.

gates.name: complete_block_Schur_fee
gates.detail: Both row and column sums are bounded; their geometric mean gives the Hilbert operator norm.

gates.name: displayed_full_smoothing_budget
gates.detail: Displayed constant leaves room for all fixed shell endpoint conventions.

gates.name: final_high_row_sum
gates.detail: The true two errors are much smaller; hence ||P_b U|| < 2 in every stated H^s.
